issues.where: the large animal in the foreground pool
issues.what: the flank cuts abruptly into the mud, with a pale straight strip along the edge and no visible meniscus or disturbed water; the body looks dropped through the surface
issues.fix: break up the contact line, darken and gloss the submerged skin, and carry displaced water and ripples around the flank

issues.where: the standing adult's feet, the juvenile at right, and the animal lying across the foreground
issues.what: the legs end as blunt stumps in the same muddy texture, and the prone body disappears into the red water without displacing it; the animals look embedded rather than weighted or submerged
issues.fix: show how the weight deforms the mud under each foot and add a distinct wet edge and water disturbance around the immersed body

issues.where: the lower-left shore beneath the animal and the right-hand mud crop
issues.what: the shore breaks into triangular ridges and the mud repeats the same corrugated relief across wet and dry areas, like one displaced sheet
issues.fix: break up the displacement with irregular bank geometry and give pooled water, slick mud, and exposed sediment distinct surface finishes

issues.where: the ground under the feet in both crops and the bank at lower right
issues.what: there are sharp triangular facets, smeared texture, and a stepped, vertically stretched lip in the pale bank
issues.fix: refine the bank geometry and use scale-consistent material mapping with irregular sediment and crust at the lip

issues.where: the adult's flank in the upper-right crop and mouth appendages in the lower-right crop
issues.what: the flank has a soft web of dark lines that looks printed over a smooth volume, while the appendages have nearly identical smooth plastic highlights and blunt ends
issues.fix: give the skin distinct folds and roughness at several scales, and vary appendage shape, tip detail, and wetness

issues.where: the midground red pool, pale mound at lower left, and shallow mud at lower right
issues.what: the red pool reads as a uniform ripple pattern with little trace of the nearby trunks in reflection, while the pale mound has stretched streaks and the shallow mud lacks a distinct wet margin
issues.fix: add broken local reflections and depth variation to the pool, and give the mound and mud margin separate, scale-appropriate materials
